Confirmed. I opened Edit, clicked the × on the "Recipes" chip, and saved — the "Recipes" chip is gone from the bookmark, the "Work" chip is still there, and over in the sidebar the Recipes count dropped while Work stayed. So removing one label leaves the others alone, which is exactly what I'd expect.

That settles the label-removal behavior for me. Let's move on to search.
